import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
from sklearn.preprocessing import LabelEncoder
import lightgbm as lgb
import os

os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

# Load data
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")

# Extract IDs and target
train_ids = train_df["id"]
test_ids = test_df["id"]
target = train_df["target"].values

# Drop unnecessary columns
train_df = train_df.drop(["target", "id"], axis=1)
test_df = test_df.drop(["id"], axis=1)


# Process f_27: split into 10 separate character columns
def extract_char_features(df):
    char_df = pd.DataFrame()
    for i in range(10):
        char_df[f"f_27_{i}"] = df["f_27"].str[i]
    return char_df


train_chars = extract_char_features(train_df)
test_chars = extract_char_features(test_df)

# Drop original f_27
train_df = train_df.drop(["f_27"], axis=1)
test_df = test_df.drop(["f_27"], axis=1)

# Combine with char features
train_df = pd.concat([train_df, train_chars], axis=1)
test_df = pd.concat([test_df, test_chars], axis=1)

# Identify categorical columns (object type)
cat_cols = [col for col in train_df.columns if train_df[col].dtype == "object"]

# Encode categorical features with LabelEncoder
for col in cat_cols:
    le = LabelEncoder()
    # Fit on combined data to avoid unseen categories
    combined = pd.concat([train_df[col], test_df[col]], axis=0).astype(str)
    le.fit(combined)
    train_df[col] = le.transform(train_df[col].astype(str))
    test_df[col] = le.transform(test_df[col].astype(str))

# Create engineered features
num_cols = [
    col
    for col in train_df.columns
    if col not in cat_cols and train_df[col].dtype in ["int64", "float64"]
]


def create_features(df):
    df["num_mean"] = df[num_cols].mean(axis=1)
    df["num_std"] = df[num_cols].std(axis=1)
    df["num_max"] = df[num_cols].max(axis=1)
    df["num_min"] = df[num_cols].min(axis=1)
    return df


train_df = create_features(train_df)
test_df = create_features(test_df)

all_features = train_df.columns.tolist()
X = train_df[all_features].copy()
y = target
X_test = test_df[all_features].copy()

# Split for validation
X_train, X_valid, y_train, y_valid = train_test_split(
    X, y, test_size=0.15, random_state=42, stratify=y
)

# LightGBM parameters tuned for speed and performance
params = {
    "objective": "binary",
    "metric": "auc",
    "boosting_type": "gbdt",
    "num_leaves": 31,
    "learning_rate": 0.05,
    "feature_fraction": 0.8,
    "bagging_fraction": 0.8,
    "bagging_freq": 5,
    "min_child_samples": 20,
    "verbosity": -1,
    "seed": 42,
    "n_jobs": -1,
}

# Create datasets
train_data = lgb.Dataset(X_train, label=y_train)
valid_data = lgb.Dataset(X_valid, label=y_valid, reference=train_data)

# Train model with fewer rounds and early stopping
model = lgb.train(
    params,
    train_data,
    num_boost_round=200,
    valid_sets=[valid_data],
    callbacks=[
        lgb.early_stopping(stopping_rounds=25),
        lgb.log_evaluation(period=0),
    ],
)

# Validation prediction
valid_pred = model.predict(X_valid)
val_auc = roc_auc_score(y_valid, valid_pred)
print(f"Validation AUC: {val_auc:.6f}")

# Test prediction
test_pred = model.predict(X_test)

# Create submission file
sample_sub = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")
submission = pd.DataFrame({"id": test_ids, "target": test_pred})
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
